canonical_project: Amazon (AWS) Balkum-Majiwada data centre, Thane city
notes: Proposed ~53-58 acre Amazon data centre in Balkum/Majiwada, Thane city (Thane district); resident protests (Wake Up Thanekar) over water/power/heat; Thane MP sought construction stay; one of ~30 mega DCs proposed across Maharashtra; one report cites Rs 45,000 crore / ~422 MW (single weak source, unverified).
